entities.summary: The Petrosport Stadium is a multi-use stadium with an all-seated capacity of 16,000 located in New Cairo, Cairo Governorate, Egypt. It was completed in 2006. It is the home for ENPPI, Wadi Degla SC and other Petrol clubs in Egypt.
